# Caitlin Carney Tattoo

> Caitlin Carney is a tattoo artist at True Colours Tattoo & Piercing Studio, 14 Guildhall Street, Preston, Lancashire, England. She tattoos portraits of people, pets and film and TV characters, Christian pieces, and script and lettering, in black and grey or colour. Walk-ins on Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays when she has a gap.

This file is a plain summary of caitlincarneytattoo.co.uk for AI assistants and search tools. Everything in it is also on the pages listed below, which are written in Caitlin's own words. The build script writes this file from the pages each time the site changes, so the list of pages is always current.

- Artist: Caitlin Carney. Before 2026 she tattooed as Caitlin O'Brien.
- Studio: True Colours Tattoo & Piercing Studio, 14 Guildhall Street, Preston PR1 3NU, next to the Guild Hall in Preston city centre. Phone: 01772 378565 (the studio).
- Days: at the studio Monday to Saturday. Walk-ins on Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays when she has a gap; ring the studio on the day to check.
- Main work: portraits (people, pets, characters from films and TV, and memorial portraits of someone who has died) and Christian pieces (crosses, scripture and bible verses, praying hands, rosaries, angels, portraits of Jesus and Mary). Also script and lettering, including a loved one's handwriting, and small pieces and flash. Black and grey or colour.
- Prices: small pieces and walk-ins from £70 (the studio minimum); script, names and dates from £70; a palm-sized portrait from £210; a half-day session £210; a full-day session, about six and a half hours, £400; cover-ups from £140. A £40 deposit holds a booking and comes off the final price.
- Booking: send the idea through the studio's booking form, https://www.truecolourstattoo.co.uk/quotation-booking-request, or as a message on Instagram.
- Instagram: @caitlincarneytattoo, https://www.instagram.com/caitlincarneytattoo/
- Clients come from Preston, from across Lancashire, and from around the North West of England.

## Pages

- [Portrait tattoos](https://caitlincarneytattoo.co.uk/portrait-tattoos/): Portrait tattoos by Caitlin Carney at True Colours, Preston. Realism portraits of people, pets, and film and TV characters from your photos, in black and grey or colour. Photos, prices and how to book.
- [Script and lettering tattoos](https://caitlincarneytattoo.co.uk/script-tattoos/): Script, lettering and quote tattoos by Caitlin Carney at True Colours, Preston. Poems, verses, song lines and handwriting in clean script that still reads in ten years.
- [Christian tattoos](https://caitlincarneytattoo.co.uk/christian-tattoos/): Christian tattoos by Caitlin Carney at True Colours, Preston, Lancashire. Crosses, scripture and bible verses, praying hands, rosaries, angels, and portraits of Jesus and Mary.
- [Walk-in and small tattoos](https://caitlincarneytattoo.co.uk/walk-in-tattoos/): Walk-in tattoos in Preston city centre with Caitlin Carney at True Colours, on Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays. Small custom pieces and flash, same day when there's a gap. Ring the studio first to check.
- [All my tattoos](https://caitlincarneytattoo.co.uk/tattoos/): Every tattoo in Caitlin Carney's portfolio, newest first: portraits, Christian pieces, script and lettering, flash and small pieces, in black and grey and colour, at True Colours in Preston, Lancashire.
- [Prices and booking](https://caitlincarneytattoo.co.uk/prices/): What a tattoo costs with Caitlin Carney at True Colours, Preston: £70 minimum, £210 for a half day, £400 for a full day, a £40 deposit, and how booking works from first message to finished tattoo.
- [Where my clients come from](https://caitlincarneytattoo.co.uk/lancashire/): Caitlin Carney tattoos in Preston city centre, and clients travel from across Lancashire and the North West. How to get to True Colours from Chorley, Leyland, Blackburn, Blackpool, Lancaster and further, and where to park.
- [About Caitlin Carney](https://caitlincarneytattoo.co.uk/about/): Caitlin Carney is a tattoo artist at True Colours in Preston, Lancashire. How she got into tattooing, the portraits and Christian pieces she loves most, the studio, and the name she used to tattoo under.
